part.text: All 435 tests pass. The bug was a missing `if`/`return False` around the value comparison in the plain-mapping branch of `OrderedMultiDict.__eq__` (and the duplicated `__eq__` in `QueryParamDict` within `urlutils.py`) — the result of `other[selfk] == self[selfk]` was being discarded, so only key presence mattered.
